_comment: Bluesky custom feeds, one per group of councils. A feed carries every post from the councils listed. 'basis' records the grouping the membership comes from (joint organisation, regional organisation of councils, state planning or development region, or a media market). Names are at most 24 characters and ids at most 15 (used as the feed record key).
